playbooks.title: Username investigation
playbooks.intent: Assess public presence without treating a handle match as identity proof.
steps: Normalize the handle and note platform context.
Run broad username discovery.
Open only relevant public profiles and preserve provenance.
Compare profile-native metadata, timelines and public media.
Record contradictions and alternative explanations.
Report candidates with confidence, not certainty.

playbooks.title: Domain and infrastructure investigation
playbooks.intent: Build historical and technical context around a domain using passive sources.
steps: Normalize the registrable domain and subdomains.
Check registration/RDAP context.
Review certificate transparency and DNS context.
Check third-party indexed services.
Review historical web captures.
Correlate changes by time and avoid equating shared hosting with ownership.

playbooks.title: URL verification
playbooks.intent: Understand a public URL while minimizing direct interaction.
steps: Normalize URL components.
Prefer passive third-party scan/archive context before direct navigation.
Review historical captures and reputation context.
Extract domain and infrastructure pivots.
Preserve exact observations and timestamps.
Separate reputation signals from factual page evidence.

playbooks.title: Image verification
playbooks.intent: Assess provenance, reuse and location clues from a lawfully obtained image.
steps: Preserve the original file and hash it.
Inspect metadata without assuming it is trustworthy.
Run reverse-image/visual searches.
Extract visual landmarks and text clues.
Use map/satellite context to test location hypotheses.
Document alternative matches and uncertainty.

playbooks.title: Company and organization research
playbooks.intent: Corroborate organization identity and public-record relationships.
steps: Normalize legal name, aliases and registry identifiers.
Start with official registry/filing sources.
Cross-check international identifiers and third-party indexes.
Review officers, addresses, filings and procurement records where lawful.
Test whether shared addresses are intermediaries rather than operational links.
Build a dated relationship map with source provenance.

playbooks.title: Document provenance and extraction
playbooks.intent: Extract and verify information from a lawfully obtained public document.
steps: Preserve original and compute a hash.
Extract metadata and text.
OCR only when needed and preserve the original.
Extract URLs, names, dates and identifiers as candidate pivots.
Verify claims against primary sources.
Record transformations and tool versions.

playbooks.title: Defensive IOC enrichment
playbooks.intent: Enrich a defensive observable without turning reputation into attribution.
steps: Classify the IOC type and observation time.
Query multiple defensive enrichment sources.
Collect passive infrastructure and historical context.
Map relevant behaviors to ATT&CK only when evidence supports it.
Record conflicting labels and freshness.
Report confidence and explicitly avoid unsupported actor attribution.

playbooks.title: Geolocation verification
playbooks.intent: Test a location hypothesis using public geospatial evidence.
steps: Normalize coordinates/place names.
Compare multiple map providers.
Check street-level imagery where lawfully available.
Use satellite/terrain context.
Validate sun/shadow or topography only as supporting signals.
Document imagery dates and alternative locations.

playbooks.title: Brazil public-record research
playbooks.intent: Use Brazilian official/open data with identifier normalization and provenance.
steps: Define the legal/ethical purpose and relevant identifier.
Normalize CNPJ or other public identifiers.
Prefer Receita/IBGE/official portals before aggregators.
Cross-check procurement, transparency or sector-specific data only when relevant.
Treat shared corporate addresses as weak relationship evidence.
Report source dates, field definitions and gaps.
